result:
Done. Here's what was built across 4 TDD cycles:

**`src/components/SubscriberList.tsx`** — new component receiving `subscribers` from `Dashboard` and rendering the accessible list, email links, and topics.

**`src/components/SubscriberList.test.tsx`** — 4 tests covering the zero case (empty list), names, email `mailto:` links, and comma-separated topics.

**`src/components/Dashboard.tsx`** — refactored to delegate the list markup to `<SubscriberList subscribers={subscribers} />`. Dashboard still owns the data; all existing Dashboard tests continue to pass because they assert on visible text, not component identity.
